item.title: REPORT | Wrexham AFC 1-0 Ipswich Town (FA Cup)
item.description: Wrexham AFC booked their place in the Fifth Round of the FA Cup, as Josh Windass’ 34th minute strike earned the Red Dragons a 1-0 victory over Ipswich Town. Goalkeeper Alex Palmer was called into action early-on, but chances were few and far between before Windass broke the deadlock 11 minutes prior to the interval. item.title: GALLERY | Wrexham AFC 1-0 Ipswich Town
item.description: Wrexham AFC put themselves into the hat for the FA Cup Fifth Round for the first time since 1997 with victory over visiting Ipswich Town. Phil Parkinson made five changes to his starting XI, including a return for Ryan Longman and Josh Windass, as well as Sam Smith, George Dobson and George Thomason. item.title: U18 REPORT | Wrexham AFC 0-1 Port Vale
item.description: Wrexham AFC Under-18s suffered their first defeat of 2026, as they lost 1-0 at home to Port Vale. It means their six-match unbeaten run has come to an end, having secured wins over Shrewsbury Town, Morecambe, Southend United, and Walsall, and drawn with Oldham Athletic and Blackpool. item.title: MATCH OFF | Swansea City Women vs Wrexham AFC Women postponed
item.description: Wrexham AFC Women’s Genero Adran Premier fixture away to Swansea City has been postponed due to a waterlogged pitch at the Llandarcy Academy of Sport. The match, our first of Phase Two, was originally scheduled to take place today (Sunday February 15) at 2pm, but constant rain in South Wales has made the pitch unplayable. A new date will be announced in due course.

item.title: FA CUP DRAW | Red Dragons to face Chelsea
item.description: Wrexham AFC will host Chelsea in the Fifth Round of the Emirates FA Cup. The Red Dragons beat fellow Championship side Ipswich Town in the Fourth Round, thanks to a 34th minute Josh Windass strike, which was enough to earn victory over The Tractor Boys and progress to the Fifth Round for the first time since 1997.
